# netactuate_cloud_routing_router_routing_overview (Data Source)

Reads a Cloud Routing Router Routing Overview.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netactuate_cloud_routing_router_routing_overview" "example" {
  router_id = 12345
  vrf_id    = 12345
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `router_id` (Number) Cloud router ID.
- `vrf_id` (Number) VRF ID.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `overview` (String) Routing overview for the VRF as compact JSON.
